inputs.fx_note: Model in SEK (statements and flows), quote in USD (Nasdaq ADS, 1 ADS = 1 Class B share). Rate SEK->USD 0.099578 = 1/10.0424 from Yahoo SEK=X (USD/SEK) regularMarketTime 2026-10-03T21:00Z. Parity check: ERIC-B.ST SEK 93.18 (Nasdaq Stockholm close 2026-10-02) / 10.0424 = USD 9.279 vs ADS USD 9.29, a 0.1% tie that confirms rate, direction and the 1:1 ADS ratio. Note USD/SEK is at the top of its 52-week range (8.77-10.08); the Q3-26 company outlook assumed 9.7. Unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are USD; SEK twins are the engine's model-currency values.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 3,371.35m shares issued less 108.52m treasury at 2026-09-25 (6-K filed 2026-09-28) = 3,262.8m basic outstanding, plus ~9m LTV dilution (Q2-26 diluted avg 3,322m vs basic 3,313m) = 3,272m. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the SEK 15bn buyback (Apr-26 to Mar-27) is the cash mechanism, already counted where spent. The Q3-26 buyback cash (not yet on a balance sheet) is deducted in equity_bridge so shares and cash are on the same date.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in SEK, the currency of the flows: Swedish 10y government ~2.6% + beta ~1.1 x Swedish/European ERP ~5.6% = ~8.8% cost of equity; Ericsson is net cash so WACC = CoE, rounded to 9.0%. Same 9.0% in every scenario: cyclicality, Huawei pricing, memory-cost inflation and the Enterprise drag are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not as a rate premium (adaptations 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B) leases as operating cost: lease cash (principal SEK ~1.94bn TTM + lease interest ~0.3bn) charged via lease_cost_pct_path at 1.0% of revenue; lease liabilities (SEK 8.0bn at 2026-06-30) EXCLUDED from net debt. Ericsson's own net cash definition (gross cash less borrowings) already excludes leases, and its 'FCF before M&A' deducts lease repayments, so this matches the company's convention. da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is ~1% of net income (H1-26 SEK 30m of 4,963m). Flows are consolidated; NCI equity of SEK 718m (2026-06-30) deducted once in equity_bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF + non-US/cyclical adaptations (dcf-methods routing: operating company, non-US, cyclical telecom-equipment capex cycle, leases, dual currency). No MEMORY.md entry existed; this is the first valuation. ANCHORS: FY0 is TTM to 2026-06-30, not FY2025, so the revenue base and the balance sheet (Q2-26 6-K, filed 2026-07-14) share a date; Q3-26 results are due mid-October 2026. FY2025 cash in the CSV is cash-only (SEK 43,926m, KPI CashOnly) per the financial-parser note; net cash here is taken from the Q2-26 report's own reconciliation instead: cash 41,691 + IB securities current 12,413 + non-current 37,193 = gross cash 91,297, less borrowings 9,468 + 21,990 = 31,458 -> net cash 59,839 (FY2025 year-end on the same definition was 61,236). TTM revenue = 56,239 + 69,285 + 49,332 + 52,691 = 227,547. ONE-OFFS: TTM EBIT includes the SEK 7.6bn iconectiv divestment gain (Q3-25) and SEK ~4.4bn of H1-26 restructuring; TTM adjusted EBITA 40,950 ex-gain = ~33.4bn (14.7%). ebitda_margin_path is defined as adjusted EBITA + non-acquired D&A (~2.9% of sales) less a normalised restructuring charge (~0.5% of sales; elevated ~1.3% in year 1 per 'restructuring 2026 elevated') -- i.e. engine margin ~= adjusted EBITA margin + 2.4pp in steady state. Base mature 17.4% = adjusted EBITA ~15.0%, the low end of the company's 15-18% target. OWNER FCF: reported_fcf = TTM OCF 33,782 - capex (PPE + capitalised development) 3,997 - lease principal 1,939 = 27,846; less SBC 175 and interest received 2,418 (net cash 59.8bn >> 1x the FCF base, so interest is stripped) = 25,253. TTM OCF is flattered by contract-liability inflows; the component year-1 owner FCF (~9.3% margin) sits below the TTM 11.1%. BUYBACKS: first ever programme, SEK 3.23bn H1-26 (financing cash), ~43.6m more shares repurchased Jul-Sep 2026 (treasury 64.9m -> 108.5m); Ericsson is a genuine repurchaser, so the flat count is being funded. SBC is ~0.08% of revenue: house and street bases essentially coincide (near-SBC-zero), so band_position is not informative here. Iraq/DOJ investigation (ongoing, unquantified) is not provisioned and is carried in the bear narrative, not the bridge.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue_5yr_cagr 0.4% (10yr -0.4%: SEK 246.9bn FY2015 -> 236.7bn FY2025) lifted to roughly nominal-inflation growth; equity and EPS CAGRs are not usable (see warning)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 4.8% vs revenue 0.4% and EPS 10.1% diverge >30%. Equity is distorted by the Vonage impairments (FY2023 Q3 SEK -30.5bn NI, FY2024 Q2 -11.0bn) and record distributions; FY2025 EPS 8.51 includes the SEK 7.6bn iconectiv gain. Revenue is the only clean anchor and it has been flat in SEK for a decade.
historical_growth.notes: FY basis, SEK millions. Owner FCF = OCF - capex(PPE+capitalised dev, CSV) - SBC - interest income - lease principal: FY2020 ~20,330, FY2022 21,640, FY2025 24,613. Owner-FCF CAGRs sit ~1.4pp (3yr) below reported, driven by rising interest income on the growing cash pile, not by SBC (SBC is ~0.07% of revenue). FCF growth since FY2023 is a margin recovery from the 2023 trough (FY2023 FCF 1,707), not compounding.

base.growth_rationale: Year 1 (Jul-26..Jun-27) +3% = organic ~-1% (RAN market flat per Dell'Oro, North America Networks -5% YoY in Q2-26, IPR down vs the 2025 settlement) plus ~+4% FX translation (USD/SEK 10.04 vs ~9.4-9.6 averaged over the TTM; ~half of sales USD-denominated). Year 2 +1.5% (flat RAN into 2027), then 2.5-3% as 5G SA / uplink and early 6G spend arrives ~2029-30, fading to 2%.
base.margin_rationale: TTM adjusted EBITA ex-iconectiv ~14.7%. Year 1 15.4% (adj. EBITA ~13%): memory/DRAM cost inflation building into 2027 (Q3-26 Networks GM guide 48-50%, ~100bp down) and restructuring elevated. Recovers to 17.4% (adj. EBITA ~15.0%, low end of 15-18% target) by year 5 as price increases and cost actions offset input costs.
base.wc_rationale: Hardware/projects business: inventories + receivables + contract assets (~SEK 77bn) roughly offset by payables + contract liabilities (~74bn); growth mildly consumes cash, so capture is negative.
base.tax_rationale: Cash taxes paid SEK 7.0bn FY2025 / 6.3bn FY2024 on underlying EBIT ~SEK 28-31bn = ~22-25%; Swedish statutory 20.6% blended with higher-rate US/EM jurisdictions.

bull.margin_rationale: Mature 19.4% = adjusted EBITA ~17%, upper half of the 15-18% target: IPR run-rate grows beyond SEK 13.5bn, pricing actions fully offset memory inflation, Enterprise breaks even.

bear.margin_rationale: Mature 14.9% = adjusted EBITA ~12.5%, back to the FY2023-24 run-rate: memory inflation is not passed through, Huawei price pressure in open markets, Enterprise keeps losing money.

scenario_narratives.base: The global RAN market stays flat through 2027 (Dell'Oro) and North America digests the AT&T-led share gains, so organic sales are roughly flat and reported growth in year 1 comes from the weak krona. AI-driven DRAM/custom-silicon inflation compresses Networks gross margin into 2027 (Q3-26 guide 48-50%) before cost actions and the structural price increases management is negotiating restore adjusted EBITA to ~15%, the low end of the 15-18% target. IPR holds its ~SEK 13.5bn recurring base, Enterprise/Vonage stabilises but contributes little, and a 5G-SA/uplink then early-6G cycle around 2029-30 gives 2.5-3% growth before fading to 2%. The SEK 59.8bn net cash funds the SEK 15bn buyback and SEK 3/share dividend without stretching the balance sheet.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI traffic moving to the edge (uplink, 5G SA, FWA past 160m subscribers) triggers a genuine operator capex upturn from 2028 and an early 6G cycle; Ericsson keeps its trusted-vendor share in the West as Huawei exclusions widen, IPR licensing grows beyond SEK 13.5bn with new smartphone and IoT licensees, memory inflation is fully passed through, and Enterprise reaches break-even. Adjusted EBITA reaches ~17% and revenue compounds 4-5% for five years.
scenario_narratives.bear: Memory and custom-chip inflation persists and is not passed through to operators, who stay capital-disciplined into a long post-5G air pocket; North America declines further, India stays paused and Huawei takes open markets on price, while the new CEO restructures again and Enterprise keeps losing money. Revenue falls ~5% over two years and adjusted EBITA settles back at the FY2023-24 run-rate of ~12.5%. Further tail risks (DOJ Iraq investigation, a further Vonage write-down) are not in the flows.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: revenue has been flat in SEK for a decade, the company has guided to a multi-quarter input-cost headwind with no AI data-centre offset, and Morgan Stanley's Sept-26 downgrade reflects a flat RAN market into 2027. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things (a capex upturn, IPR growth, full cost pass-through, Enterprise turnaround) to go right at once. Base at 50%. No solvency tail: SEK 59.8bn net cash.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Ericsson is a cyclical, ex-growth duopolist in Western RAN with a large net-cash balance and a high-margin patent stream. It is valued on SEK owner FCF built from components (adjusted EBITA + non-acquired D&A, less normal restructuring and lease cash, less cash tax and capex), discounted at a SEK 9% rate with risk charged in the scenario flows. The terminal value is capped at 10-14x FCF because a business whose revenue has not grown in a decade should not be capitalised at a growth multiple. Pension deficit, the October dividend tranche and post-balance-sheet buyback cash are deducted so the per-share value reflects claims ahead of the ADS holder.
key_risks_to_valuation: Memory/DRAM and custom-silicon inflation not passed through (Networks gross margin guide already down ~100bp for Q3-26)
Flat global RAN market into 2027 and North America decline after share-gain years
USD/SEK at a 52-week high (10.04): SEK strength reverses the year-1 translation tailwind and cuts the USD value of SEK flows one-for-one
Enterprise/Vonage continues to lose money; further impairment
DOJ Iraq investigation (unprovisioned) and the FCPA compliance legacy
Pension liability sensitivity to Swedish government bond yields (SEK 18.0bn IFRS vs 9.9bn on covered-bond basis)
